headword: {連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}

definitions.gloss: serialized novel; serial novel; novel published in installments
definitions.explanation: A novel published in successive installments in a newspaper, magazine, or online platform.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}の{連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}を{毎日|まいにち}{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: I read the serialized novel in the newspaper every day.

examples.japanese: あの{作家|さっか}の{連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}が{来月|らいげつ}から{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: That author's serialized novel starts next month.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}が{完結|かんけつ}し、{単行本|たんこうぼん}として{出版|しゅっぱん}された。
examples.english: The popular serialized novel was completed and published as a book.

notes:
Compound of {連載|れんさい} (serialization) + {小説|しょうせつ} (novel). A major tradition in Japanese publishing — many famous Japanese novels were originally serialized in newspapers or literary magazines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}を{書|か}く: to write a serialized novel
- {連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}が{完結|かんけつ}する: for a serialized novel to conclude
- {新聞|しんぶん}{連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}: newspaper serial novel

CULTURAL NOTE:
Newspaper serialization has been central to Japanese literary culture since the Meiji era. Many classic works by {夏目漱石|なつめそうせき}, {川端康成|かわばたやすなり}, and others first appeared as {連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}. Today, web novels ({ウェブ小説|うぇぶしょうせつ}) have become a modern form of serialization.
